youtube_description:
When Dakota is not in his awesome turbo diesel vw bus he is spending his time scaling a glacier or guiding tourists through the Alaskan rain forest....not bad for a van dweller. And as a disclaimer, I shot this video in September of 2016 and he still hasn't got his website set up. It could be he spent a considerable amount of time overseas as a temp worker or he is too busy living to worry about a website. But rest assured, once he gets a site up I will be sure to link it to this video.
